description: Asked which hunger was hers, and whether to lay a trencher.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Carried the heel of the loaf, took the sixpence, refused to salt the house early, and told the stair to expect him by nine.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Sat three rows ahead and did not speak.
name: Sir John Spencer

description: Turned the glass twice, said he would be brief, and kept Wednesday's reading for Wednesday.
name: Master Josias Thwaite

description: Named Wednesday's salt, paid the sixpence, left Gib on the Ovid, and promised to be in close on nine.
name: William Shakespeare
